categories.epithelium: Epithelium, glands and skin: cells lining surfaces, ducts, airways, gut, kidney tubules, glands and epidermis
categories.connective: Connective tissue, fat, cartilage and bone
categories.muscle: Muscle: smooth, skeletal or cardiac muscle cells
categories.blood: Blood and immune cells: red cells, platelets, white cells, macrophages and their precursors
categories.nervous: Nervous system: neurons, glia, Schwann cells and retina
categories.reproductive: Reproductive: sperm, eggs and supporting cells of testis

cells.name: Enterocyte
cells.description: absorptive tall columnar cell of small intestine villi with a microvilli brush border and basal nucleus

cells.name: Goblet cell
cells.description: wine-glass shaped columnar cell full of pale mucin that secretes mucus in intestine and airway

cells.name: Ciliated cell
cells.description: columnar epithelial cell with motile cilia on its surface lining the airways, bronchi and fallopian tube

cells.name: Squamous cell
cells.description: keratinocyte; flat or polygonal squamous cell of skin epidermis and esophagus that makes keratin, with intercellular bridges

cells.name: Umbrella cell
cells.description: large dome-shaped superficial urothelial cell lining the bladder, sometimes binucleate

cells.name: Type I pneumocyte
cells.description: very thin flat cell lining lung alveoli for gas exchange

cells.name: Type II pneumocyte
cells.description: cuboidal alveolar lung cell that makes surfactant in lamellar bodies and regenerates alveolar lining

cells.name: Mesothelial cell
cells.description: flat cell lining pleura, peritoneum and pericardium with surface microvilli

cells.name: Endothelial cell
cells.description: flat cell lining the inside of blood vessels and capillaries

cells.name: Thyroid follicular cell
cells.description: cuboidal cell lining thyroid follicles filled with colloid, makes thyroid hormone

cells.name: Myoepithelial cell
cells.description: contractile cell wrapped around glands and ducts in breast, salivary and sweat glands

cells.name: Parietal cell
cells.description: pink fried-egg cell of gastric glands in the stomach body that secretes acid and intrinsic factor

cells.name: Chief cell
cells.description: basophilic blue gastric gland cell at the base of stomach glands that makes pepsinogen

cells.name: Paneth cell
cells.description: cell at the base of small intestinal crypts with bright red eosinophilic apical granules containing lysozyme

cells.name: Hepatocyte
cells.description: large polygonal pink liver cell with central round nucleus, makes bile and proteins, detoxifies

cells.name: Pancreatic acinar cell
cells.description: pyramidal exocrine pancreas cell with apical zymogen granules that secretes digestive enzymes

cells.name: Beta cell
cells.description: endocrine cell of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans that makes insulin

cells.name: Podocyte
cells.description: kidney glomerulus cell with interdigitating foot processes wrapping capillaries to filter urine

cells.name: Proximal tubule cell
cells.description: cuboidal pink kidney tubule cell with a brush border that reabsorbs filtrate

cells.name: Melanocyte
cells.description: dendritic pigment cell in the basal epidermis that makes brown melanin

cells.name: Fibroblast
cells.description: spindle-shaped connective tissue cell with a thin wavy nucleus that makes collagen and scar

cells.name: Adipocyte
cells.description: large round fat cell storing a single lipid droplet with a flattened peripheral nucleus

cells.name: Chondrocyte
cells.description: cartilage cell sitting in a lacuna surrounded by blue hyaline matrix

cells.name: Osteocyte
cells.description: mature bone cell trapped in a lacuna with thin canaliculi in mineralized bone

cells.name: Osteoblast
cells.description: bone-forming cell that lays down osteoid, lining bone surfaces

cells.name: Osteoclast
cells.description: huge multinucleated cell that resorbs and eats away bone in a Howship lacuna

cells.name: Smooth muscle cell
cells.description: spindle-shaped involuntary muscle cell with a cigar-shaped nucleus in vessel walls and gut

cells.name: Skeletal muscle fiber
cells.description: long striated voluntary muscle fiber with many peripheral nuclei

cells.name: Cardiomyocyte
cells.description: branching striated heart muscle cell with a central nucleus and intercalated discs

cells.name: Red blood cell
cells.description: erythrocyte; red biconcave disc without a nucleus that carries oxygen with hemoglobin

cells.name: Platelet
cells.description: tiny anucleate cell fragment that forms clots and stops bleeding

cells.name: Neutrophil
cells.description: white blood cell with a multilobed segmented nucleus, first responder to bacteria and acute inflammation, forms pus

cells.name: Eosinophil
cells.description: white blood cell with a bilobed nucleus and bright red orange granules, in allergy, asthma and parasites

cells.name: Basophil
cells.description: rare white blood cell packed with dark purple blue granules containing histamine

cells.name: Lymphocyte
cells.description: small round white blood cell with a large dark round nucleus and scant cytoplasm; T cells and B cells of adaptive immunity

cells.name: Plasma cell
cells.description: oval cell with an eccentric clock-face nucleus and perinuclear halo that makes antibodies

cells.name: Monocyte
cells.description: large white blood cell in blood with a kidney-shaped folded nucleus that becomes a macrophage

cells.name: Macrophage
cells.description: large tissue phagocyte that eats bacteria, debris and dead cells, foamy or with vacuoles; histiocyte

cells.name: Mast cell
cells.description: tissue cell full of metachromatic histamine granules that degranulates in allergy and anaphylaxis

cells.name: Megakaryocyte
cells.description: huge bone marrow cell with a large multilobulated nucleus that makes platelets

cells.name: Dendritic cell
cells.description: antigen-presenting immune cell with long branching processes, including Langerhans cells in skin

cells.name: Neuron
cells.description: nerve cell with a cell body, prominent nucleolus, dendrites and a long axon that sends electrical signals

cells.name: Purkinje cell
cells.description: large flask-shaped cerebellar neuron with a huge branching dendritic tree

cells.name: Astrocyte
cells.description: star-shaped glial support cell of the brain with many processes, GFAP positive, forms glial scars

cells.name: Oligodendrocyte
cells.description: glial cell of the brain with a round nucleus and clear perinuclear halo that myelinates central axons

cells.name: Microglia
cells.description: small resident immune cell of the brain with a rod-shaped nucleus and thin branched processes

cells.name: Schwann cell
cells.description: peripheral nerve glial cell that wraps myelin around axons

cells.name: Rod photoreceptor
cells.description: light-sensing cell of the retina in the eye with stacked discs for dim light vision

cells.name: Sperm cell
cells.description: spermatozoon; male gamete with a head and a long swimming flagellum tail

cells.name: Oocyte
cells.description: egg cell; very large round female gamete in the ovary with a zona pellucida

cells.name: Sertoli cell
cells.description: tall supporting nurse cell of testis seminiferous tubules that supports developing sperm

cells.name: Leydig cell
cells.description: pink interstitial cell of the testis that makes testosterone, with Reinke crystals
